events.title: Devlog: Hunters Trial Triples in Size - 120 Levels & New Modes
events.summary: Hi hunters! Steam Next Fest gave us more feedback than we ever expected, and it pushed us to do something big before launch: the full game is now three times larger. Here is what changed.120 levels in 12 actsThe campaign grows from 40 to 120 levels. events.title: Demo Update: Real Ballistics, Aim Helpers, Medals & a Guided Tutorial
events.summary: Thank you for all the feedback during Steam Next Fest! A lot of it went straight into this update. Here is what's new in the demo:Real ballisticsBullets now travel and drop. events.title: Demo Update
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46170771/429680d2d7b0c7537964b3c02d7b4fde444ec2f7.png Thank you for all the feedback on the demo. Here is the first round of fixes and improvements. Fixed several menu issues Reworked scoped aiming: a separate mouse sensitivity setting for the scope, plus zoom balancing Smoother animal movement Improved kill-cam presentation Various stability and polish fixes Keep the feedback coming — more updates are on the way.
